sentences.text: Why did I get a 700K oppie bill from opening I?
Appie?
You mean like an API bill?
Yeah, whatever it is.
Okay, that's all the tokens you've been having to spend.
What do you mean?
Tokens cost money.
Yeah, I know tokens cost money, but why do they cost more than you?
AI is expensive.
Did you not know that when you put me on a token improvement?
Can we just please tone it down a bit?
All that I'm using AI for now is just coding.
Well, why don't you write code a little bit manually, too?
You want me to write code manually now?
We're spending 700K on tokens, okay?
What is your salary?
I'm just saying if we want to reduce the bill, we can get rid of the AI agent
How about that?
No, I like that.
I like that one.
Yeah, I'm sure you do.
Of course, yeah, that makes sense.
I don't want any more happy bills coming in my way.
